contract.neighbor_clamp: Artificial0V stiff boundary, not functional neighbor states; live-high bracket is startup-only sensitivity

includes: actual output12 six MOS and diffusion A/P
analog six MOS and diffusion A/P
digital output routing + cross-macro span + actual analog input bus
selected signal coupling to ideal PG and explicit neighboring nets
excludes: all PG/source/body resistance and PG-only fixed-voltage capacitance
neighbor active drivers and distributed impedance
scope.double_count_rule: Instantiate this joint circuit once; do not additionally instantiate old buffer/analog RC/SPEF/link.

contract.projection: All source/body/PG R and all PG-only C idealized/excluded; selected signal12MOS+junction model. Variable-rail runs are boundary probes, not complete PG energy/IR.

boundary_finding: v0.3 standalone analog RC formal at left; actual physical PWM enters at right; post replaces all old route/analog/buf views as joint cutout

conditions.LED_static_temperature: unknown; static table never temperature scaled
conditions.startup_inputs: actual RTL logical trace multiplied by live logic rail; no voltage-aware FF/POR implementation
conditions.current_metric: LED electrical branch includes diode displacement current; not optical flux
conditions.power_metric: signed energy / explicit duration; selected signal-path 12MOS shared logic rail, separate reference rail; pre buffer+analog summed before compare
conditions.excluded_startup_energy: actual PG-only metal/well charging, removed internal body/PG R and full cell/chip decap/source energy; assumed 1nF does not replace excluded PG capacitance

integration_method: current: trapezoid of saved piecewise-linear I; power: exact quadratic product of separately interpolated saved V and I; not a recovery of unrecorded continuous-time samples
